"Cookie missing from the jar, mom looks for it everywhere. She checks under chairs and on shelves."  "The child climbed a stool to reach some cookies but slipped down with them in hand before dropping all over my feet!"  "Dad asked me if I saw anyone taking his cookie while he was distracted by work outside; now I'm worried about what happened next at the backyard picnic, where everyone is too busy talking not noticing anything suspicious."  "Oops! Spilled milk on mom's favorite dish and she just wiped it off with a cloth. She always seems to know how much water we need in our sink during those sunny days when we're all gathered around for breakfast inside school by that window seat overlooking the garden, so peaceful yet filled now only half-empty dishes are left."  "Mom was very upset because her favorite cookie went missing from under my bed; she couldn't believe someone could be sneaky like this. She told me to always watch out and not let anyone near our things without permission."   "The kids were playing with a ball in the backyard when mom called us inside for lunch, but we saw something strange on their tattered blanket that looked suspiciously similar."  "While cleaning up after breakfast yesterday morning at home by my favorite spot next door to school; I found this peculiar blue ribbon stuck between two broken tiles. It's as if someone or some creature was trying very hard not so good in hiding it."   "Dad asked me what happened with the cookie, but I'm afraid I'll never know because mom just went off on a tangent about how she always feels like she's being watched by invisible eyes whenever something goes missing."  "Mom said that I should clean up my toys and then help her wash dishes. She seemed very upset when we couldn't find any cookies left in our house; it was as if the whole kitchen had vanished into thin air, leaving just empty plates on every counter."   "Dad mentioned a strange noise outside while he went to get some water from his spigot that I thought sounded like someone sneaking around. Mom decided it's best not talk about what she saw when we were looking for cookies."  "Mom found her missing cookie under the couch and seemed relieved, but then started talking in circles saying something might have been stolen by a bird or maybe even an overboard ship."   "Dad asked me if I heard anything unusual last night while he was distracted outside; now I'm worried about what happened next at school when mom suddenly changed topics to how she felt so depressed and alone without her favorite cookie."
